    pattern=re.compile(r'([+-]?)(?:(\d+)([a-zA-Z])?|([a-zA-Z]))(?:\^([+-]?\d+))?')
    def parse(s):

        while pos<len(s):

            if sign=='-':c=-c
            e=int(exponent) if exponent is not None else (1 if v1 or v2 else 0)
            out[e]=out.get(e,0)+c;pos=m.end()

def min_acquire_cost(stations, capacity):
